epic-workspace-comms.title: Workspace Active Communication Layer
epic-workspace-comms.description: Make multi-repo workspaces truly communicate like a real dev team — pre-dev impact checks, peer queries, post-change broadcasts, quality gates, locks, event bus, and more. 15 stories covering the full active communication lifecycle.

epic-enforcement-gates.title: Mechanical Enforcement Gates v3.0
epic-enforcement-gates.description: Replace prompt-only safeguards with hook-level mechanical enforcement that blocks tool execution. 4 gates: Verification-Required, Strike Escalation, Bugfix Scope, Revert-First Protocol.

epic-episodic-memory.title: Externalized Episodic Memory + State Capture Enforcement
epic-episodic-memory.description: Eliminate conversational context bloat: route curated conclusions to state files (mechanically enforced), externalize noisy tool outputs to disk with breadcrumbs, promote worth-keeping content before cleanup. Target: 30%+ token recovery on continuation turns, 3-5x more tasks per session in bulk mode. Architecture: Layer 1 state capture (primary), Layer 2 tool-output externalization (safety net), Layer 3 promotion pipeline (preservation).

wf-a48fafdd.title: Autonomous Epic Execution — end-to-end walk-away mode across solo + workspace
wf-a48fafdd.description: User can dump N items, say 'go until you finish', walk away, return to terminal summary. 4 stories (A: worker boot fix, B: workspace parity, C: NL autonomous mode, E: epic decompose-and-run). See .workflow/epics/wf-a48fafdd.md

epic-quality-loop.title: Continuous Code-Quality Initiative
epic-quality-loop.description: Always-on quality infrastructure: scheduled audits/regression/PR-review (read-only-by-default), portable skill export, pluggable execution backends, and a data-driven gate-miss → rule-proposal loop. All net-additive, human-in-loop preserved at every decision boundary.

epic-workspace-sustained-exec.title: Workspace channel-dispatched workers: sustained autonomous execution
epic-workspace-sustained-exec.description: Fix verified root cause: channel-dispatched workers stall after one turn because no Stop-gate forces continuation of an IN-PROGRESS decomposed task. Primary mechanism: Stop-hook {continue:true} keeps the same worker session alive, sidestepping flaky channel wake-up and preserving in-context decomposition. 6 dependency-ordered stories S1-S6.

epic-audit-remediation-2026-05-29.title: Audit Remediation 2026-05-29 — fix all confirmed findings
epic-audit-remediation-2026-05-29.description: Fix all 28 adversary-validated findings from the 2026-05-29 /wogi-audit (score B/80). No-deferral directive. 6 dimension-stories. 3 owner-decision points: D-F4 huggingface upgrade, C-F6 decisions.md write, #28 branch deletion.
